categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在把LLM能力迁移到专业领域信号与Agent经验固化，同时关注标注、审计与微调带来的可信与隐私风险。

articles.title: LEMMO: A Large Electromagnetic Model leveraging Pretrained LLMs for Million-Sample Signal Understanding
articles.zh: LEMMO：利用预训练LLM构建百万级样本信号理解的大型电磁模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做电磁信号识别，这篇说明把LLM的预训练能力迁移到射频信号上，百万级样本规模的性能提升有戏
articles.author: Mingkai Li, Jiajun Wu 等
articles.body: Large language models have expanded beyond text to vision, audio, and other modalities, but understanding raw electromagnetic (EM) signals remains challenging. Wideband recordings can contain millions of samples, whereas existing waveform-based EM models are primarily evaluated on short in-phase and quadrature (IQ) segments, leaving long-recording understanding and detailed description insufficiently explored. We introduce LEMMO, a large EM model for instruction-driven recognition and description of long raw IQ recordings. LEMMO combines a linear-attention EM encoder with anti-aliased temporal resampling to process up to eight million complex samples. Its EM-text interaction module conditions learnable queries on instructions before retrieving signal evidence. Compact queries support recognition, while structured queries with auxiliary factual supervision organize scene-level properties, signal attributes, and cross-signal relationships for detailed description. We also construct and release a unified 1.38-TB corpus of real-world and synthetic EM signals, including LEMMO-ShortQA and LEMMO-LongDesc. Compared with MERLIN-LoRA, LEMMO improves mean EM-Bench perception accuracy by 15.77 %, mean strategy-generation ROUGE-L F1 by 4.38 points, and mean LEMMO-ShortQA accuracy by 14.31 %. It also improves categorical and numerical fact F1 on both LEMMO-LongDesc tasks while preserving its language backbone's MMLU performance. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/N1rv4n4/LEMMO and https://huggingface.co/datasets/DaftJun/RFLAS, respectively.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（Large language models）早就不是只管文字了，已经扩展到视觉、音频和其他模态（modalities），但要让它们直接理解原始电磁（EM）信号，还是挺难的。宽带记录（wideband recordings）动不动就包含几百万个样本，而现有的基于波形的电磁模型（waveform-based EM models）大多只在很短的、同相和正交（IQ）片段上做评估，长录音到底怎么理解、怎么详细描述，其实还没充分研究。我们推出了 LEMMO，一个大型电磁模型（large EM model），专门用来做指令驱动的长原始 IQ 记录识别和描述。LEMMO 把线性注意力电磁编码器（linear-attention EM encoder）和抗混叠时间重采样（anti-aliased temporal resampling）结合起来，最多能处理八百万个复数样本（complex samples）。它的电磁-文本交互模块（EM-text interaction module）会先根据指令调整可学习查询（learnable queries），再去取信号证据（signal evidence）。紧凑查询（compact queries）用来做识别；带辅助事实监督（auxiliary factual supervision）的结构化查询（structured queries）则把场景级属性（scene-level properties）、信号属性和跨信号关系（cross-signal relationships）组织起来，用于详细描述。我们还搭建并公开了一个统一的 1.38TB 语料库（corpus），里面有真实和合成的电磁信号，包括 LEMMO-ShortQA 和 LEMMO-LongDesc。跟 MERLIN-LoRA 比，LEMMO 在 EM-Bench 上的平均感知准确率（perception accuracy）提高了 15.77%，策略生成（strategy-generation）的 ROUGE-L F1 平均提高 4.38 分，LEMMO-ShortQA 的平均准确率提高 14.31%。在两个 LEMMO-LongDesc 任务上，类别和数值事实（categorical and numerical fact）的 F1 也有提升，同时语言主干模型（language backbone）在 MMLU 上的表现保持不变。代码和数据集分别放在 https://github.com/N1rv4n4/LEMMO 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/DaftJun/RFLAS。

articles.title: ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation
articles.zh: ENGRAM：通过可验证巩固将Agent经验转化为模型权重
articles.summary: 如果你在纠结Agent的记忆该放向量库还是塞进参数，这篇给了一条"经验经检验后写进权重"的路线
articles.author: Ruiyi Yang, Zechen Li 等
articles.body: Language-model agents use experience through external retrieval and parameter learning. Consolidating stored experience into model weights requires deciding both which experience to train on and when its external records can leave retrieval. Admission based solely on student mastery can exclude useful teacher demonstrations, while removal immediately after training can discard guidance that the model still needs. We introduce ENGRAM, a framework that separates training admission from memory release. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills based on student mastery or sufficient successful teacher demonstrations. The student learns from selected action traces with context from an Engram Trace Graph (ETG). A verification gate then compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. Release requires valid training participation and scores meeting both relative and absolute criteria; records for skills that fail verification remain retrievable. Experiments across interactive and reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over frozen-weight ETG controls, with ablations supporting demonstration-aware admission and selective adapter activation. A controlled held-out comparison shows that verified release substantially reduces the retrievable footprint while remaining close to retain-all performance and outperforming immediate and budget-matched random release. ENGRAM also improves task performance while reducing input-token usage and model calls. Skill-level verification further reduces retrievable experience through selective archival, retaining external guidance for skills that do not meet the release criteria. Code is available in anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous.
articles.bodyZh: 语言模型智能体（language-model agents）会通过外部检索（external retrieval）和参数学习（parameter learning）来利用经验。要把存下来的经验固化进模型权重，得同时决定两件事：拿哪些经验来训练，以及这些经验的外部记录什么时候能退出检索。如果只看学生模型有没有掌握就决定准入，可能把有用的教师示范挡在外面；而训练一结束就马上移除，又可能把模型还需要的外部指导扔掉。我们提出了 ENGRAM，一个把“训练准入”和“记忆释放”分开的框架。一个示范感知门控（demonstration-aware gate）会根据学生模型已经掌握，或者教师已经给出足够多成功示范，来决定某个技能能不能进入训练。学生模型从选中的动作轨迹里学习，上下文来自 Engram 痕迹图（Engram Trace Graph，ETG）。然后验证门控（verification gate）会在预留探针（reserved probes）上，把更新后、不带情景检索（episodic retrieval）的模型，和带检索的基座模型做对比。想释放记忆，得同时满足：确实有效参与了训练，并且分数达到相对和绝对两套标准；没通过验证的技能，其记录仍然保持可检索。在交互类和推理类基准测试上的实验显示，相比冻结权重的 ETG 对照组，它稳定更好；消融实验也支持示范感知准入和选择性适配器激活（selective adapter activation）这两个设计。一个受控的留出对比（held-out comparison）显示，经过验证的释放能大幅缩小可检索足迹（retrievable footprint），性能又接近“全部保留”（retain-all），并且优于训练后立刻释放和预算匹配的随机释放（budget-matched random release）。ENGRAM 还能提升任务表现，同时减少输入 token 用量和模型调用次数。技能级验证还能通过选择性归档（selective archival）进一步减少可检索经验，同时给没达到释放标准的技能保留外部指导。代码在 anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous 可以拿到。

articles.title: Definitions, Label Names, or Demonstrations? Auditing What Governs LLM Annotation
articles.zh: 定义、标签名还是示例？审计究竟是什么在主导LLM标注行为
articles.summary: 如果你靠LLM批量打标注，这篇提醒你真正决定标注结果的可能不是你以为的那个提示词部件
articles.author: Viraj Mishra, Shubham Gupta 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate social-science texts, but high accuracy does not establish that they apply researcher-supplied category definitions: predictions may instead reflect prior associations with category labels or labeled demonstrations. We introduce a counterfactual audit that reassigns definitions among output labels, distinguishing adherence to supplied definitions from preservation of a dataset's original mapping. Across three political-text datasets, models rarely follow reassigned definitions, and standard fine-tuning strengthens the original mapping without reliably increasing definition adherence. We then study retrieval-augmented annotation. Retrieving the nearest training examples generally outperforms retrieving examples separately within each category despite using fewer demonstrations. On the two tasks with substantial gains, direct \(k\)-nearest-neighbor classification recovers 74--93\% of the improvement, indicating that neighborhood labels provide much of the predictive signal. Relabeling fixed demonstrations redirects predictions, whereas aligning demonstrations with reassigned definitions substantially increases adherence to the new mapping. Thus, accuracy-improving interventions need not increase codebook adherence; definitions, category labels, demonstrations, retrieval, and training data should be aligned and validated jointly.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）现在越来越多地被用来给社会科学文本做标注，但准确率高，并不能证明它们真的按研究者给的定义来分类：它们的预测可能只是反映了对类别标签的既有联想，或者是在照着带标签的示例（demonstrations）走。我们做了一种反事实审计（counterfactual audit）：把定义在输出标签之间重新分配，从而区分模型到底是在遵守给定的定义，还是在保留数据集原来的映射（mapping）。在三个政治文本数据集上，模型很少遵循重新分配后的定义；而标准微调（fine-tuning）会强化原来的映射，却不能可靠地提高模型对定义的遵守程度。接着我们研究了检索增强标注（retrieval-augmented annotation）。检索最近的训练样本，通常比在每个类别里分别检索示例效果更好，尽管前者用的示例更少。在两个提升明显的任务上，直接用 k 近邻分类（k-nearest-neighbor classification）就能找回 74%到93%的提升，这说明邻近样本的标签提供了很大一部分预测信号。给固定示例重新贴标签，会改变模型的预测方向；而让示例和重新分配后的定义保持一致，则会明显提高模型对新映射的遵守程度。所以，能提高准确率的方法，不一定能提高对编码手册（codebook）的遵守；定义、类别标签、示例、检索和训练数据，应该放在一起对齐、一起验证。

articles.title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
articles.zh: 从LoRA到语言：从适配器中还原技能文档
articles.summary: 如果你把微调当黑盒资产来用，这篇说明LoRA里藏着的技能描述可以被反推出来，模型即文档也是泄露面
articles.author: Saranya Dintakurthy Swadha, Pavan C Shekar 等
articles.body: Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill's adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original's task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers (1-2% of instructions). For these adapters we test an agent that runs the base and adapted models and writes a skill from where they differ. On ALFWorld its skills recover 58-71% of a LoRA's gain and carry over to models that cannot load the LoRA, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5% to 55%. Whether such a skill comes from the adapter depends on what the adapter learned: when its behaviour cannot be guessed, the adapter is the source; when it can, a reward loop without the adapter does as well.
articles.bodyZh: 智能体技能（agent skills）就是一些短文档，用来教语言模型（language model）怎么处理某一类任务。为了省上下文，这些文档越来越多地被编译进低秩适配器（low-rank adapters, LoRA）里，适配器保留了行为，却把文本弄丢了：一个适配器很难读、很难改、很难审查，也很难搬到另一个模型上。我们想搞清楚：能不能从适配器和它那个冻结的基座模型（base model）里，把技能文档再写回来？每还原出一份文档，我们就看两件事来打分：它写出了原文档里多少关键指令（key instructions），以及它能解决哪些任务。我们试过的方法里，光靠读权重（weights），几乎还原不出什么东西；用一个学出来的“权重到文本”的映射，也只传回来大概一个比特（bit）的原文档信息。让适配器跑起来，效果就好多了。“执行型写手（Executing Writer）”是一个在适配后的模型之上训练的小型写手，它能把没见过的留出技能（held-out skills）里 39% 到 44% 的关键指令还原出来；换成另一个技能的适配器，只有 1.3% 到 1.5%。而在针对 41 个外部技能拟合出来的适配器上，它写出的文档能找回原技能 85% 到 91% 的任务增益（task gain）。这些最漂亮的结果，来自训练时把技能文档也存进去的适配器；如果适配器只学行为、不存文档，训练过的写手就难多了，只能还原 1% 到 2% 的指令。针对这类适配器，我们测试了一个智能体（agent）：它同时跑基座模型和适配后的模型，再根据两者表现不一样的地方，写出一份技能文档。在 ALFWorld 环境里，它写出的技能能找回 LoRA 带来增益的 58% 到 71%，而且还能迁移到那些根本加载不了这个 LoRA 的模型上，把 Llama-3.1-8B 的表现从 5% 提到 55%。这种技能到底是不是从适配器里“榨”出来的，要看适配器学到了什么：如果它的行为没法靠猜，那适配器就是信息源；如果猜得出来，那不用适配器、只靠奖励循环（reward loop）也能做得一样好。

articles.title: Not All Entropy Is Equal: Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.zh: 并非所有熵都等价：可验证奖励强化学习中的奖励条件熵分配
articles.summary: 如果你在调RLVR的探索策略，这篇告诉你熵该按奖励信号分区投放，一刀切的熵正则是在浪费算力
articles.author: Song Yu, Li Li 等
articles.body: Policy entropy is widely used to diagnose exploration and collapse in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), yet its magnitude does not consistently track reasoning performance across optimization objectives. We argue that this ambiguity arises because global token entropy conflates uncertainty in successful and failed trajectories, diversity across correct solution strategies, and variation among realizations of the same strategy. We introduce \textbf{Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation (RCEA)}, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that separates complete-trajectory entropy from average token entropy, conditions uncertainty on verifier outcome and process validity, measures correct-solution-mode retention, and connects these population-level quantities to local covariance-driven updates. In controlled sweeps over six RLVR objectives at two model scales, entropy trajectories do not induce a stable ordering of reasoning accuracy. Token entropy is higher for verifier-failed than successful trajectories under both broad separately aggregated estimates and a common-question paired analysis, whose confidence intervals exclude equality at 10 of 12 displayed endpoints. A local covariance approximation predicts the direction of adjacent-checkpoint entropy change in 95.5\% of nonfailed transitions; a reward-stratified endpoint proxy further shows that positive chosen-token covariance is more tail-concentrated within failed prefixes. Every reportable trained endpoint exhibits some contraction in independently audited correct-solution-mode breadth, whose positive association with large-\(k\) coverage remains exploratory. These results show that entropy collapse should be diagnosed by which uncertainty is removed, rather than by global entropy alone.
articles.bodyZh: 大家常用策略熵（policy entropy）来判断可验证奖励的强化学习（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, RLVR）里探索得够不够、有没有塌掉，但它的数值大小并不能稳定反映推理表现，尤其是在不同优化目标下。我们认为，这种模糊性来自：全局 token 熵把成功轨迹和失败轨迹里的不确定性、不同正确解法之间的多样性，以及同一种解法不同实现之间的差异，全都混在一起了。为此我们提出“奖励条件化熵分配”（Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation, RCEA），这是一个分层诊断框架：它把整条完整轨迹的熵和平均 token 熵分开看，把不确定性按验证器结果和过程有效性来条件化，衡量正确解模式的保留情况，并把这些群体层面的量和局部协方差驱动的更新联系起来。在两种模型规模、六个 RLVR 目标的控制性扫描里，熵的走势并不能稳定地排出推理准确率的高低。无论是在分开汇总的宽口径估计下，还是在同一个问题配对的比较分析下，验证器判定失败的轨迹，其 token 熵都比成功轨迹更高；后者的置信区间在展示出来的 12 个端点里有 10 个都不包含“两者相等”。一个局部协方差近似方法，能在 95.5% 的非失败转变里预测相邻检查点熵变化的方向；一个按奖励分层的端点代理指标还显示，正向的被选 token 协方差在失败前缀里更集中在尾部。每个可报告的已训练端点，在独立审计的正确解模式广度上都出现了一定收缩，而它和大 k 覆盖率之间的正相关目前还只是探索性结果。这些结果表明，诊断熵坍缩应该看“到底是哪一类不确定性被去掉了”，而不是只看全局熵。

articles.title: Logit Laundering: Evading Data-Use Auditing in Large Language Models
articles.zh: Logit洗白：规避大语言模型中的数据使用审计
articles.summary: 如果你依赖logit层面的信号做数据溯源审计，这篇证明这条路可被绕过，审计结论得换个抓手
articles.author: Ruihan Hu, Wei Luo 等
articles.body: Data-use auditing in Large Language Models (LLMs) aims to determine whether the given data has been used for training, thereby supporting data ownership safeguards. A dominant solution is data watermarking, which embeds traceable signals into training data and detects them in model outputs. Recent studies have proposed many watermarking-based auditing methods in LLMs. However, systematic investigation from an adversarial perspective remains limited: non-compliant LLM providers would use unauthorized copyrighted datasets for training their own models to enhance model capabilities, while attempting to evade detection by auditors, thereby avoiding legal liability. To fill this research gap, we propose a novel evasion framework, termed Logit Laundering, where the non-compliant LLM provider manipulates model outputs at inference time to undermine detectable watermark signals. Specifically, we design a logit reshaping module to suppress watermark-induced statistical signals by integrating a statistical bias estimator as a plug-and-play component. This design keeps the model parameters unchanged and performs manipulation only in the logit space, thereby enabling auditing evasion while minimizing the impact on model's learned knowledge. To further balance evasion effectiveness and model utility, we introduce a confidence-aware scaling module to adaptively calibrate the suppression strength based on next-token prediction confidence. Extensive evaluations show that Logit Laundering can successfully evade existing various state-of-the-art auditing methods, significantly attenuating detectable signals, while preserving model utility on downstream tasks. Our work highlights the need for exploring more robust auditing methods to guard against evasion behaviors.
articles.bodyZh: 在大语言模型（LLMs）里，数据使用审计（data-use auditing）想搞清楚一件事：某份数据到底有没有被拿去训练模型，从而给数据所有权保护撑腰。现在最主流的做法是数据水印（data watermarking）：把可追踪的信号埋进训练数据里，再在模型输出里把它们检测出来。最近不少研究提出了基于水印的 LLM 审计方法，但从对抗视角（adversarial perspective）做的系统研究还很有限：有些不合规的 LLM 服务商（non-compliant LLM providers）会偷偷拿未经授权的版权数据训练自己的模型，提升模型能力，同时还想方设法躲过审计方的检测，好逃避法律责任。为了补上这个空缺，我们提出了一个新的规避框架，叫 Logit Laundering：不合规的 LLM 服务商在推理阶段动手脚，篡改模型输出，把本来能检测到的水印信号压下去。具体来说，我们设计了一个 logit 重塑模块（logit reshaping module），把统计偏置估计器（statistical bias estimator）作为一个即插即用（plug-and-play）组件接进来，专门压掉水印带来的统计信号。这个设计不动模型参数，只在 logit 空间（logit space）里做操作，所以既能躲审计，又尽量少影响模型已经学到的知识。为了进一步平衡规避效果和模型可用性，我们还加了一个置信度感知缩放模块（confidence-aware scaling module），根据下一个 token 预测置信度（next-token prediction confidence）自适应调整压制强度。大量评估表明，Logit Laundering 能成功躲过现有各种最先进（state-of-the-art）的审计方法，把可检测信号明显削弱，同时在下游任务（downstream tasks）上还能保住模型效用。我们的工作也说明，得赶紧研究更抗打的审计方法，来防住这种规避行为。

articles.title: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
articles.zh: DexDICE：用双专家离线模仿学习调和安全性与性能
articles.summary: 如果你在训练灵巧操作策略，这篇给了一个不必在"能干活"和"不出事"之间二选一的离线模仿方案
articles.author: Seokin Seo, Sung Kuk Shyn 等
articles.body: Ensuring high returns while providing strong safety guarantees in offline imitation learning (IL) is a fundamental challenge: existing approaches either rely on explicitly specified cost functions, which are difficult to design for complex real-world safety constraints, or require expert demonstrations that are both safe and high-performing, which are often too costly to collect. We introduce dual-expert imitation learning, which leverages two complementary data sources: (i) safety-compliant demonstrations that faithfully follow safety guidelines but may be suboptimal, and (ii) performance-oriented demonstrations that achieve high returns but may violate safety guidelines. To address this problem, we propose DexDICE (Dual-expert offline imitation learning via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation). Instead of conventional distribution constraints, DexDICE combines DICE-style offline learning with safe support constraints, enabling agents to exploit high-return behaviors while remaining within safety-compliant regions. We prove that the ideal solution satisfying this constraint exactly has zero unsafe-region visitation with high probability. We evaluate DexDICE on a re-curated DSRL benchmark and validate it on a real-world mobile-robot navigation task trained directly from human teleoperation demonstrations, where it substantially outperforms baselines and remains robust to data scarcity and quality degradation.
articles.bodyZh: 在离线模仿学习（imitation learning, IL）里，既想拿到高回报，又想有很强的安全保障，这本身就是一个根本难题：现有方法要么依赖明确指定的代价函数（cost function），可面对现实世界里复杂的安全约束，这种函数很难设计；要么需要既安全又表现好的专家示范（expert demonstration），但这类数据往往采集成本太高。我们提出双专家模仿学习（dual-expert imitation learning），它利用两种互补的数据来源：一是安全合规示范（safety-compliant demonstration），严格遵循安全规范，但表现可能不是最优；二是性能导向示范（performance-oriented demonstration），回报很高，但可能违反安全规范。为了解决这个问题，我们提出 DexDICE（Dual-expert offline imitation learning via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation，双专家离线模仿学习，基于平稳分布校正估计）。DexDICE 没有采用传统的分布约束（distribution constraint），而是把 DICE 风格的离线学习和安全支撑约束（safe support constraint）结合起来，让智能体能够利用高回报行为，同时仍待在不违反安全规范的范围内。我们证明了，满足这个约束的理想解，在高概率下对不安全区域的访问次数为零。我们在重新整理过的 DSRL 基准（benchmark）上评估 DexDICE，并在一个真实世界的移动机器人导航任务（mobile-robot navigation task）上做了验证——这个任务直接用人远程操作示范（human teleoperation demonstration）训练；结果显示，DexDICE 明显优于各个基线方法（baseline），而且面对数据稀缺和数据质量下降时依然很稳。

articles.title: Agentic AI for Healthcare Claim Denial Analysis: A Policy-Grounded Framework for Privacy Preservation
articles.zh: 面向医疗理赔拒付分析的Agentic AI：一个隐私保护的政策依据框架
articles.summary: 如果你想把Agent塞进医疗理赔这种强合规场景，这篇的"政策依据+隐私保护"框架可以直接当落地模板参考
articles.author: Sofia Campos, Carlos Martins 等
articles.body: In the healthcare sector, claim denials impose significant financial and administrative burdens, emphasizing the need for automated and trustworthy decision-support systems. This paper proposes a modular Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework for healthcare claim denial analysis, integrating specialized agents for denial risk prediction, risk factor identification, diagnosis-procedure-medication code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis. The framework integrates predictive analytics, graph-based learning, a Hybrid Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in healthcare policy documents, and a dedicated HIPAA Compliance Agent to support privacy protection. Evaluated on a synthetic healthcare claims dataset, the framework achieved 98% traceability of reported numerical findings, validated 214 of 216 policy citations, and removed all 280 identified sensitive identifiers without modifying the underlying analysis. These findings pave the way for further research into Agentic AI as a framework for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving healthcare claim denial management.
articles.bodyZh: 在医疗行业，理赔拒付（claim denials）会给财务和行政带来很大负担，所以大家越来越需要自动化又可信的决策支持系统。这篇论文提出了一个模块化的智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）框架，用来分析医疗理赔拒付，里面集成了多个专门智能体，分别负责拒付风险预测、风险因素识别、诊断-手术-药物代码关系分析，以及反事实分析。这个框架把预测分析、基于图的学习、一个以医疗政策文件为依据的混合上下文检索增强生成（RAG）流程，还有一个专门的HIPAA合规智能体（HIPAA Compliance Agent）整合在一起，用来支持隐私保护。在一个合成的医疗理赔数据集上评估时，这个框架让报告出来的数值结果达到98%的可追溯性，验证了216条政策引用中的214条，还在不改动底层分析的情况下，移除了全部280个识别出的敏感标识符。这些发现为后续研究打下了基础，去探索如何把智能体AI（Agentic AI）作为框架，用于可解释、懂政策、保护隐私的医疗理赔拒付管理。
